panic_hardening.message:
glib: collections: Fix theoretical use-after-frees if dropping an item panics

This is currently not a problem because all collections require the item
type to implement `TransparentType` or `TransparentPtrType`, which are
unsafe traits that are only implemented by the `glib::wrapper!` macro
and require the `Drop` impl to not panic (among other things).

As such this has no effect right now but is cleaner and might avoid bugs
in the future if the requirements of the two traits are ever weakened.

Thanks to JuHyung Son for reporting.

other_checked_fixes.message: glib: Avoid more integer overflows when reserving space in `PtrSlice` / `Slice` / `StrV`

glib: Fix `PtrSlice::from(Slice)` on empty ptr slices

Fixes https://github.com/gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core/issues/2042
